responses.draft_cover_letter:
I am excited about the API Platform Engineer role at Harbor Commerce. My background includes designing and delivering production‑grade REST APIs and building Node.js microservices, both of which align directly with the core responsibilities of the position.

In my most recent role I designed and built REST APIs using Python, FastAPI, and SQLAlchemy, providing clean contract‑first interfaces for internal and external consumers. I also developed Node.js microservices that powered a parcel‑tracking system, handling high request volumes with low latency. To ensure reliability, I introduced Prometheus and Grafana monitoring, cutting incident detection time by half and delivering the observability needed for high‑traffic services.

While I have not yet worked with GraphQL, Apollo Federation, API versioning, rate limiting, or specific authentication frameworks, I am eager to expand my skill set in these areas. I approach new technologies with the same disciplined engineering mindset that has driven my past successes.

I look forward to contributing my REST and Node.js experience, along with a strong focus on observability, to help Harbor Commerce create robust, scalable public APIs.
